prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up, high-resolution image of a bakery display overflowing with a rich assortment of freshly baked pastries. The composition is tightly framed, filling the entire scene with golden-brown croissants, pain au chocolat, and other flaky, layered pastries, some drizzled with white icing and others studded with chocolate chips. The pastries are arranged in a slightly chaotic, inviting heap, emphasizing abundance and variety. The lighting is warm and soft, casting gentle highlights on the glossy, buttery surfaces and enhancing the textures of the crisp, flaky layers. The background is softly blurred, focusing attention on the intricate details and appetizing sheen of the pastries in the foreground. The overall style is naturalistic and mouthwatering, evoking the sensory experience of stepping into a bustling European bakery at dawn.
